plain: A product name and personality an operator gives the model, such as a branded assistant.
eli5: The robot wearing a name badge that says "Aria" while working in one shop.
technical: A custom AI identity an operator assigns; Claude's constitution allows personas because Anthropic practises meta-transparency, but Claude in persona must not deny being an AI to a sincere question or directly deny being Claude, and the Model Spec treats the same questions with different defaults.
